annotations.title: Turn on a mailbox's report hook

description: Turn on bounce and complaint reports for this send-only mailbox, or give the hook a new secret. For Mailgun, Resend and SendGrid, pass `secret`: the signing key, signing secret or public key the service shows you. For Postmark leave it out: we make a password and answer it once, in this answer only. For Amazon SES pass `topicArn`, the SNS topic that carries SES's bounce and complaint notices, and no secret: an AWS subscription confirms itself once we prove its signature, and `hook.confirmedAt` says when. Then give the service the URL in `hook.url`. A report counts only when the service proves it is theirs and it names one of this mailbox's own sends; then a bounce that says the address is gone, or a spam complaint, puts that send's recipient on the list. Needs `setup`: an owner's session or a whole-workspace key made by the current owner. A person's successful set or disable closes every pending, unexpired manage_report_hook request for this mailbox in the same transaction, even without its link. A key's write closes none. Without setup, ask the owner with create_handoff (kind manage_report_hook, with this mailbox's id).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

secret.description: The secret the service made: Mailgun's HTTP webhook signing key, Resend's signing secret (starts with whsec_) or SendGrid's verification public key. Leave it out for Postmark, which has none: we make a password and answer it once.

topicArn.description: Amazon SES only: the ARN of the SNS topic SES publishes its bounce and complaint notices to. Not a secret. Leave it out for every other service.

name: set_mailbox_report_hook
title: Turn on a mailbox's report hook
